%1$s is an asset (token) issued on Bitcoin blockchain as colored coin. %1$s transaction is a bitcoin transaction and requires miner\'s fee in order to be included in a block. To be able to send %1$s token to another %1$s address you need to top up your %1$s address with a small amount of BTC which will be used to fund your transaction. You can either add miner\'s fee from any account with bitcoins every time you make %1$s transaction or top up your %1$s account with a little bit more btc so you will not have to fund (means spend on miner\'s fee) each time you make %1$s transaction.

"RMC bitcoin" is a "Bitcoin Single Address" account linked to your RMC account. This account allows you to spend BTC, received from the RMC pool. All new bitcoins, mined by the pool, are proportionally distributed among RMC bitcoin accounts. \n In order to protect your assets from accidentally being "burned" while spendingAmount BTC from your "RMC Bitcoin" linked account, digital assets unspent transaction outputs (UTXO) and corresponding technical transactions (so-called "dust") are not taken into account.
